title: CHGR Decision Template
description: Artifact classification: Authoritative (governs the shape of any future Interactive Decision Session and HumanGovernanceRecord referencing it -- CHGR-001 Sec.6). No session or record-creation workflow exists this increment (Phase 143E); this type is purely descriptive/inspectable until a future increment builds an interactive session against it. Schema validity of a DecisionTemplate document proves only that it is structurally well-formed and mechanically neutral (no preselected/preferred option) -- it never proves the template was actually approved through a governed change process (CHGR-REQ-058), which is a review-process fact this schema cannot observe.

template_id.description: Stable decision-type identifier for this template (CHGR-REQ-049).

version.description: This template's own semver, immutable once referenced by any published record.

authoritative_basis.description: Citation(s) to the governing contract clause(s) that define this decision class (CHGR-REQ-050).

eligible_authority.description: Who may make this decision, named or described specifically by this template -- never a generic role lookup (CHGR-REQ-051, CHGR-001 Sec.20 NB-1 disposition: this field, not any generic GPC6-REQ-040 table citation, is the sole operative authority-eligibility mechanism).

subject_binding_rule.description: How a Decision Subject is bound to an instance of this template at creation time (CHGR-REQ-052).

options.description: The exhaustive, closed, mutually exclusive option set (CHGR-REQ-053, CHGR-REQ-057). Order is the template author's own explicit authoring order and carries no significance -- no CHGR tooling may reorder options by any other key. No option entry may declare itself preferred, recommended, or default (CHGR-REQ-057, CHGR-REQ-151): the option object's own additionalProperties:false closure structurally forbids any such field from existing at all.

required_fields.description: Field names that must be present before Confirmation is possible (CHGR-REQ-054). rationale and conditions SHALL NOT appear here unless this template's own text explicitly requires them as mandatory (CHGR-REQ-040).

optional_fields.description: Field names that may be left blank (CHGR-REQ-054).

confirmation_method.description: Which assurance level(s) this decision class's confirmation method(s) require or permit (CHGR-REQ-056).

expiry_rule.description: Whether/how a record created from this template expires (CHGR-REQ-056). Optional: absence means no expiry rule is defined.

supersession_rules.description: Who may supersede an instance of this template and under what conditions (CHGR-REQ-056).

revocation_rules.description: Who may revoke an instance of this template and under what conditions (CHGR-REQ-056).

deprecated_by.description: Optional deprecation pointer to the superseding template. A deprecated template is never deleted -- old records referencing it remain interpretable.

status.description: Template governance status. 'deprecated' templates remain resolvable; deprecated_by SHOULD be present when status is 'deprecated'.

extensions.description: Controlled additive extension container. Extensions SHALL NOT override any normative field above, alter authority semantics, weaken required validation, redefine lifecycle state, create a hidden substantive choice, or create execution capability. Empty object permitted.

consequence_text.description: Machine-rendered text describing what this choice causes (CHGR-REQ-055). Rendered verbatim, never paraphrased or summarized by tooling.

non_effect_text.description: Mandatory machine-rendered text describing what this choice does NOT cause (CHGR-REQ-055). Never optional, per GAC-REQ-043's automatic-adoption-is-forbidden pattern.

option.description: One closed-set option. No 'default', 'preferred', or 'recommended' field can exist here -- additionalProperties:false forbids any field outside this exact set (CHGR-REQ-057, CHGR-REQ-151).
